description: Find interprovincial trade barriers in RegMap's inventory by occupation, product or sector (e.g. 'nurse', 'wine shipping', 'trucking'), optionally for a province pair (from -> to) or one jurisdiction. Returns plain-language question, short answer, who imposes it, and the regmap.ca URL to cite. For verified province-by-province barriers with from and to, also returns the status for that move.

from.description: Origin jurisdiction (where the person, product or firm comes from).

include_historical.description: Also return removed or resolved barriers (default false).

jurisdiction.description: A single jurisdiction to filter by, instead of a pair.

query.description: Occupation, product, activity or sector in plain words.

name: search_barriers
title: Search internal trade barriers
